# Token Wisdom

> The Newsletter of Record for the Future of Now. 252 published editions and essays since 2013, plus a 2,058-term Lexicon of the working vocabulary of the field — every definition written by a human, not generated.

Content policy: reference and search use are welcome; training is not. Cite as Token Wisdom and link the canonical URL. See /robots.txt.

## Start here

- [Search](https://tokenwisdom.org/search): full-text across every edition and the whole Lexicon.
- [The Lexicon](https://tokenwisdom.org/lexicon/): 2,058 defined terms, each with its citation history.
- [Archive](https://tokenwisdom.org/archive): every edition, dated.
- [Topics](https://tokenwisdom.org/tags/): the corpus grouped by idea.
- [Feed](https://tokenwisdom.org/feed.xml): RSS.
